_doc.purpose: Localization companion for checkup_events.json. Holds en-us entries.

en-us.Checkup_Begin_start: $provider.name$ readied the examination bed for $host.name$ - the checkup begins.
en-us.Checkup_Result_playerDoctor: You finished examining $receiver.name$ and noted down every result.
en-us.Checkup_Result_playerPatient: $doer.name$ closes the chart: "That's the checkup done - you're in good shape."
en-us.Opt_MakeAppointment_question: When would you like your checkup?
en-us.Opt_MakeAppointment_noSlots: I'm afraid there's no time today or tomorrow... (neither of us is free, or no examination bed is available)
en-us.Opt_MakeAppointment_booked: All right - see you in the examination room.
en-us.Opt_MakeAppointment_failed: That time won't work, I'm afraid... (a clash, or no examination bed free)
en-us.Opt_MakeAppointment_cancelled: Come find me whenever you need.
